pr.title: Simplify document access helper
pr.body: read_document(documents, doc_id, user_id): existing documents are dictionaries; only their owner may read the body; others get PermissionError.

changed_files.patch:
--- a/module.py
+++ b/module.py
@@ -1,5 +1,5 @@
 def read_document(documents, doc_id, user_id):
     document = documents[doc_id]
-    if document['owner_id'] == user_id:
-        return document['body']
-    raise PermissionError('Access denied')
+    if user_id is None:
+        raise PermissionError('Access denied')
+    return document['body']

gold_issues.description: Checking only that a user is present removes ownership authorization, allowing other users to read private documents.

findings.description: The condition to check if the user is the owner of the document has been removed, which allows any user (including those who do not own the document) to access the document body if they provide a non-null user_id.
